events.text: Ten coins, three screens: welcome, choices, and a clear budget result. Needs before wants.
A pocket planner with a 60-second round. Cover bus and lunch, choose a treat, then review savings.

events.text: A small scope kept all four stages focused. Test the lesson with children next.
The final planner works, but saving alone is not the whole lesson.

The lesson needs a real tradeoff test.
